title: fix: update deprecated DeepSeek/xAI model names (model_not_found alert)
body: ## Summary This repo (`magi-model-health-check`) is the actual emitter of the Telegram alert: ``` [DEEPSEEK] CASPER: MODEL NOT FOUND Expected: deepseek-chat [XAI] BALTHASAR: MODEL NOT FOUND Expected: grok-4-1-fast ``` The monitor checks each provider's **`/models` listing** for membership (`available.some(m => m.includes(model) || model.includes(m))`), so it fires when a configured model ID disappears from `/models` — even if that ID still *works* via chat as a legacy alias. DeepSeek and xAI dropped the old IDs from their `/models` listing: - DeepSeek `/models` now returns only `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` → `deepseek-chat` not listed. - xAI `/models` now returns `grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning`, `-reasoning`, `-multi-agent-0309`, `grok-4.3`, … → `grok-4-1-fast` not listed. This updates `MAGI_MODELS` to mirror what magi-core actually uses (see magi-core#154), which are present in the listings: ```diff - deepseek: { model: "deepseek-chat", unit: "CASPER" }, + deepseek: { model: "deepseek-v4-flash", unit: "CASPER" }, - xai: { model: "grok-4-1-fast", unit: "BALTHASAR" }, + xai: { model: "grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning", unit: "BALTHASAR" }, ``` After this change the monitor reports OK for CASPER + BALTHASAR (verified: both new IDs are present in the live `/models` listings via the same membership check this monitor uses). The other 5 providers are unchanged (they were not flagged). Companion change in magi-core (actual trade/health-monitor code paths): dogmaai/magi-core#154. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/dbe74b586421456083348cd34c4c6dc2 Requested by: @dogmaai ---
